stories.title: Shoreline Stabilization Grant Application
stories.summary: The council considered Resolution No. 2024-3352 to apply for an Illinois EPA Section 319(h) Nonpoint Source Pollution Control Grant to fund shoreline stabilization at Lake Paradise and Lake Mattoon. The total project cost is $260,000, with $156,000 requested from state grant funds and $104,000 provided in local matching funds.

stories.title: Lake Mattoon Dam Patching Project
stories.summary: The council reviewed plans and specifications for patching deteriorating concrete flume joints and exposed rebar at the Lake Mattoon Dam spillway. The council voted to approve the plans and authorized soliciting competitive bids for the repair work.
